caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a vessel with a broad, rounded base that tapers upwards and then expands into a cylindrical section with a narrower neck. The vessel has two vertical, tubular protrusions at its top. It is placed on a shallow, round dish or tray with a prominent circular handle on the right side. The drawing is executed in black and white pencil or ink, with shading used to indicate contours and reflective surfaces. The entire object is contained within a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, simplified sketch of the same object within a small square. The name "J. RIZA" is inscribed in the bottom right corner within the main rectangle. The background is plain, contributing to an overall focus on the central object and its details.
title: Lamp
